newsitem.title: USA: Eli Lilly to enter research pact.
newsitem.headline: Eli Lilly to enter research pact.

text.p: Eli Lilly and Co and Aurora Biosciences Corp said Friday they entered into a collaborative research and licensing agreement to develop screening assays and Aurora's proprietary ultra-high- throughput drug screening system.
Under terms of the agreement, Lilly will provide more than $20 million during the first three years, contingent in part on the successful delivery of the ultra-high-throughput screening system.
Lilly will get the rights to use Aurora's fluorescent screening technology and Aurora's proprietary ultra-high- throughput screening system.
Lilly is a global research-based pharmaceutical company.
